description: Contributions (pp) of food and beverages, fuel and CPI excluding food and fuel to combined CPI y/y, monthly from Jan 2015: within the 2012 base to Dec 2025 and the 2024 base from Jan 2026 (base column). Asia Decoded calculation from MoSPI's published indices and weights; ex food and fuel is the residual. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/cpi_core/in_cpi_contrib.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India CPI contributions
